item.title: One scaffold, three open crystal lattices
item.description: A tetrahedral DNA-origami building block can select among cubic diamond, hexagonal diamond, and ice 0 lattices through changes made only to its four sticky ends.

item.title: Building finite objects and lattices from DNA polycubes
item.description: An inverse-design platform programs DNA-origami cubes to form finite three-dimensional objects and extended lattices while screening out competing assemblies.
